title: Choose the home composition
question: Category standard is locked. Which composition should we build?

options.label: Full-bleed study hero
options.thesis: Edge-to-edge study photo carries the first viewport; brand, one line, and CTAs sit in the calm lower band.
options.viewport: Sticky nav; full-bleed hero photo; brand + headline + CTAs; courses begin below the fold.
options.risk: Needs a strong hero image asset or it falls back to empty gradient.

options.label: Split brand + photo
options.thesis: Typography owns one half; a tall study photo owns the other — clearest offer and action.
options.viewport: Light header; RTL split hero; course rail under.
options.risk: Can feel like two pages if the split is uneven on mobile.

options.label: Catalog-forward
options.thesis: Short brand band, then the course grid is the proof in the first viewport.
options.viewport: Compact CTA band; course grid dominates; path and FAQ below.
options.risk: Brand signal is weaker if the catalog is empty or sparse.
